fullContentHtml:
IBPS RRB XIV 14th Scale-I, II, III Reserve Lists 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Institute Of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the Reserve Lists for the recruitment of IBPS RRB Bank Officer Scale-I, II, III Post and Office Assistant Mains Admit Card on the official website of the IBPS.  Online applying process for IBPS RRB 14th Officer / Clerk Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 01 September 2025 to 28 September 2025. The Officer Scale-I, II, III Interview examination was conducted on January / February 2026. Candidates who had applied for this form can download their IBPS RRB Officer Scale-I, II, III Reserve Lists 2026.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 September 2025
  • Last Date for Registration : 28 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 September 2025
  • Online Correction Form : 06-07 October 2025
  • Officer Scale-I Exam Date : 22 – 23 November 2025
  • Officer Scale-I Admit Card : 16 November 2025 Available Now
  • OA PET Exam Date : November 2025
  • OA PET Admit Card : 26 November 2025
  • OA Pre Exam Card : November, December 2025
  • OA Pre Admit Card : 06, 07, 13, 14 December 2025
  • Pre Result : 19 December 2025
  • Exam Date (Scale-II, III) : 28 December 2025
  • Admit Card (Scale-II, III) : 20 December 2025
  • Mains Exam Date (Officer Scale-I) : 28 December 2025
  • Mains Admit Card (Officer Scale-I) : 21 December 2025
  • Office Assistant Pre Result : 23 January 2026
  • Interview Date (Officer Scale-I, II, III) : January / February 2026
  • Interview Admit Card (Officer Scale-I, II, III) : 23 January 2026
  • Mains Exam Date (Office Assistants) : 01 February 2026
  • Mains Admit Card (Office Assistants) : 23 January 2026
  • Score Card (Scale I, II, III) : 13 February 2026
  • Final Result : 23 February 2026
  • Reserve Lists : 01 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
